newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian officials safe after helicopter crash.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian officials safe after helicopter crash.

text.p: A group of Indonesian officials, including two ministers, were reported to be safe on Thursday after their helicopter crashed on the western tip of Sumatra island, airport sources and a rescue official said.
The helicopter was one of several carrying officials and ministers travelling with President Suharto in Aceh province.
"We have got information that a Puma helicopter has crashed in Banda Aceh airport, but the passengers were safe," a rescue official in Jakarta said. He gave no further details.

An airport source in Jakarta, who received the information from the militarty-civilian airport serving the provincial capital of Banda Aceh, said the Puma crashed soon after take-off. Airport officials at Banda Aceh declined to comment on the incident.

The source in Jakarta said passengers in the crashed helicopter included Health Minister Sujudi, Food Minister Ibrahim Hasan and Suharto's daughter-in-law, Halima, the wife of his second son, businessman Bambang Trihatmodjo.
Suharto was visiting Aceh on Thursday for a ceremony involving a village improvement organisation.
